For a classic cheesecake, if you are out of cream cheese, you can use mascarpone cheese as a substitute. Mascarpone has a similar rich, creamy texture and mild flavor, though it is slightly richer and less tangy. To mimic the tanginess of cream cheese, you can add a small amount of lemon juice or white vinegar to the mascarpone. Another option is Greek yogurt or sour cream, but these will result in a lighter, less dense texture, so they are best used in combination with other ingredients or in recipes specifically designed for them.
